item: PETG or ASA, matt black: ring with foot, mirror carrier, hub adapter (print the ring flat, 4 walls)
note: Bambu P1S, 0.4 mm, 0.16 to 0.2 mm layers; ring is 170 mm across, fits the 256 mm bed

item: PETG or ASA, matt black: base pedestal (print upside down, no supports) and lid
NEMA 17 stepper 42/60 (The Pi Hut, 60 mm body): 1.68 A, 1.65 ohm, 6.2 mH, 0.64 N m holding, 5 mm D shaft, 0.5 kg
note: check the front-face thread is M3 on a 31 mm square

item: Stepper driver TMC2209 module (StealthChop; a slight hum is wanted, so A4988 or DRV8825 would also do)
note: step/dir, 1/16 microstep; set the motor current to about 1.2 to 1.5 A (enclosed in the pedestal, 9 W at full current); heatsink on the driver

item: ESP32 dev board (random-walk speed setpoint, acceleration limited)
note: step pulses from the RMT or a hardware timer, not a software loop

item: 24 V 3 A supply, barrel jack, 100 uF 35 V capacitor across the driver supply
note: 24 V gives the torque at several hundred rpm; 12 V works but is weaker

item: Steel or stainless rod 4 mm, 169 mm long
note: glue to the carrier with CA or retaining compound

item: Acrylic mirror 1.5 mm, 150 mm discs, laser-cut
note: try a sample first: 1.5 mm may still dish, 2 mm is stiffer

item: Brass slug 8 x 5 mm (swap for steel or aluminium, or leave out)
Steel washers or plates as ballast, about 350 g
note: ring around the motor in the pedestal

item: Heat-set inserts M3 x 5 (4 lid, 2 ring foot, 2 grub screws)
Screws: M3 x 8 cap head (motor x4), M3 x 8 countersunk (lid x4), M3 x 16 (ring foot to hub x2), M3 x 5 grub (shaft x2), M3 x 6 (ring balance trim x4)
